items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the dualizing complex of a proper curve and verifies its six defining properties (statement lines 796-825). The proof (lines 827-856) is a complete reference chain: the relative dualizing definition with adjointness giving (4), the vanishing and CM-support inputs for (1) and (2), the normalized-local criterion for (3), and the unwinding plus smooth-case citations for (5) and (6). Every step is present with no omissions; the footnote even records the Yoneda characterization of the complex. H2: a systematic assembly whose hinges are correctly ordered and whose content is the framework used by the rest of the chapter.
